population: deterministic V310 integration; excludes injected faults; does not measure Live Agent quality

tools.definition: distinct actually executed tools with verified steps / current registered railway tools

states.definition: observed committed order states / declared six-state inventory

transitions.definition: observed confirmation/expiry edges / ten declared legal edges including refund self-transitions

security.definition: passed named negative/guard/idempotency plans / seven declared checks

exceptions.definition: passed expiry/failure/invalid-parameter plans / four declared checks; timeout/truncation unmeasured

multi_turn.definition: two-turn real Mock Conversation input plan / one declared plan; not generalized context coverage

reply_consistency.definition: paid readback has no stale waiting-for-payment claim / one declared check

rag.definition: no RAG quality execution in this adapter batch

trace.definition: per-step trace identifiers and existing evidence file

models.definition: completed Live Agent execution / DeepSeek and Qwen, not model request attempts

defects.definition: controlled fault runs that fail the original independent assertions
